checks.name: schema
checks.detail: 80 records readable; missing recommended fields cell, so some checks below will skip.

checks.name: chance correction
checks.detail: one test-set shape (n=150, p=75); chance AP is 0.5154, which exceeds the base rate 0.5000 by 0.0154. Constant here, so raw AP is comparable WITHIN this file and nowhere else.

checks.name: negative control
checks.detail: 20 splits (80 records): ROC-AUC 0.4990 (-0.10 sigma), normAP +0.0039 (+0.22 sigma).

checks.name: pairing integrity
checks.detail: all 20 (seed, cell) groups share one test-label fingerprint, so paired tests over them are valid.

checks.name: unit of analysis
checks.detail: 80 records in ONE configuration = ~20 splits x 4 methods. Records sharing a split are not independent observations of it, so any claim about this configuration has n=20, not n=80.

checks.name: statistical power
checks.detail: median paired sd 0.0041 over 20 seeds gives a minimum detectable effect near 0.0027 in normAP. A null result here excludes effects LARGER than that and nothing smaller.

checks.name: precision floor
checks.detail: 3 of 6 method pairs differ by less than the declared floor of 0.001. Below it a difference is not reproducible and must be reported as such, not as a measurement.

checks.name: multiplicity
checks.detail: this file supports 6 pairwise comparisons across 1 configurations. Uncorrected, the chance of at least one spurious rejection at alpha 0.05 is about 0.26. Declare which are confirmatory, or correct (Bonferroni would be 8.33e-03).

checks.name: tuning symmetry
checks.detail: every method varied its selection: linear 1 structural / 8 C (no parameters); poly 107 structural / 9 C; quantum-angle-r1 5 structural / 7 C; quantum-angle-r2 4 structural / 7 C; quantum-iqp-r1 3 structural / 7 C; quantum-iqp-r2 3 structural / 6 C; rbf 10 structural / 7 C.

checks.name: cross-arm comparison
checks.detail: 20 (seed, configuration) groups pair across the two files on verified matching test points. Across-arm paired sd 0.0052 over 20 seeds per configuration gives a minimum detectable effect near 0.0035. THIS is the power of the comparison being made; the figure above is the power of comparisons within one arm.

checks.name: kernel conditioning
checks.detail: condition number reaches 7.5e+26 over 6 sampled kernels covering 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s). The dual is underdetermined at that conditioning, so decision scores are reproducible only to a floor you must measure and quote, and threshold-based tests such as McNemar are not usable. Rank statistics survive; check that yours are.

numbers.coverage: 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s)

checks.name: classical surrogate equivalence
checks.detail: over 6 sampled kernels the median difference from a label-free RBF surrogate is 1.66e-04 in normAP, below this pipeline's reproducibility floor of 1e-03, over 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s). On this evidence the kernel is its surrogate and the comparison is classical-versus-classical. Sampled, so it indicates rather than establishes; run the full set before reporting either way.

numbers.coverage: 4 method(s) (quantum-angle-r1, quantum-angle-r2, quantum-iqp-r1, quantum-iqp-r2) on 6 seed(s)

checks.name: selection
checks.detail: inner scores recorded alongside test scores; their rank correlation is -0.367. Selection auditable.

not_runnable.name: grid adequacy against a shuffled null
not_runnable.reason: needs a re-run, not a hook: the same pipeline on permuted labels with a widened grid. Widening raises the best inner score even when nothing is better, so hyperparameter edge flags never justify it on their own.
